notes: New: Pay later. On Sell, tap Pay later and enter who will pay: stock goes down, no cash is taken, and the receipt has a Received by line. The Cash drawer page lists who owes what. Tap Items back for unsold goods (stock returns, they owe less) and Receive payment for money, part or all.

New: each seller card has a Delete button. A seller with stock can now be deleted: a warning shows how many products and pieces go with them, and any money still owed. Their past sales and payouts stay in Reports, marked (deleted).
keynotes: Pay later: resellers take goods now and pay at the end of the day
Delete a seller from their card, even if they still have stock, after a warning

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>MGC POS</title>
<link rel="manifest" href="manifest.json">
<link rel="icon" href="icon.svg">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="icon-192.png">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#ffffff">
<script>
// Light / dark / automatic (light 6 AM to 6 PM on this device's clock) / follow the device: set before the page draws, so it never flashes
window.themeFor = function (mode) {
  var h = new Date().getHours();
  if (mode === "system") return matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches ? "dark" : "light";  // follow this device's own setting
  return mode === "auto" ? (h >= 6 && h < 18 ? "light" : "dark") : mode === "dark" ? "dark" : "light";
};
try { document.documentElement.dataset.theme = themeFor(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("theme"))); } catch (e) {}
</script>
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<style>
/* Look and feel inspired by YouTube: flat surfaces, neutral greys, pill buttons and chips; light and dark themes.
   Colors are tokens: :root is light, [data-theme=dark] is dark (chosen in Settings > Appearance). */
:root{color-scheme:light;
  --page:#f9f9f9;--bg:#fff;--panel:#fff;--raised:#fff;--ink:#0f0f0f;--muted:#606060;--line:rgba(0,0,0,.1);--line2:rgba(0,0,0,.2);
  --chip:rgba(0,0,0,.05);--chip2:rgba(0,0,0,.1);--field:#fff;--fieldline:#8f8f8f;--track:#8a8a8a;
  --strong:#0f0f0f;--onstrong:#fff;--accent:#065fd4;--red:#ff0033;--alert:#cc0000;--good:#137333;--goodsoft:rgba(19,115,51,.12);
  --warn:#a14a07;--warnsoft:rgba(180,83,9,.12);--bad:#cc0000;--badsoft:rgba(204,0,0,.08);--shade:0 4px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.16)}
/* Every text/background pair is at least 4.5:1 (WCAG AA), controls and borders 3:1, in both themes.
   --red is the logo red (icons, large text only); white text sits on --alert. */
:root[data-theme=dark]{color-scheme:dark;
  --page:#0f0f0f;--bg:#0f0f0f;--panel:#1f1f1f;--raised:#282828;--ink:#f1f1f1;--muted:#aaa;--line:rgba(255,255,255,.1);--line2:rgba(255,255,255,.2);
  --chip:rgba(255,255,255,.1);--chip2:rgba(255,255,255,.2);--field:#121212;--fieldline:#6b6b6b;--track:#777777;
  --strong:#f1f1f1;--onstrong:#0f0f0f;--accent:#3ea6ff;--red:#ff0033;--good:#4cc764;--goodsoft:rgba(76,199,100,.15);
  --warn:#f2b84b;--warnsoft:rgba(242,184,75,.18);--bad:#ff8a80;--badsoft:rgba(255,78,69,.15);--shade:0 4px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
html{background:var(--page)}
body{min-height:100vh;margin:0;font:15px/1.45 Roboto,Arial,system-ui,sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;background:var(--page);color:var(--ink);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:240px 1fr;grid-template-rows:56px 1fr;grid-template-areas:"top top" "side main"}
svg.i{width:24px;height:24px;flex:none;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}

/* header (like YouTube's top bar): menu button, logo + store name, connection status */
.top{grid-area:top;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:6;height:56px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:0 16px;background:var(--bg)}
.iconbtn{width:40px;height:40px;min-height:40px;padding:8px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:none;color:var(--ink);display:grid;place-items:center}
.iconbtn:hover{background:var(--chip)}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-width:0}
.logo{width:32px;height:32px;flex:none;display:block}
.brand b{font-size:19px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.4px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.brand sup{color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;align-self:flex-start;margin-top:12px}
#net{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);padding:6px 12px;border-radius:18px;background:var(--chip);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:55vw}
#net::before{content:"";width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--good);flex:none}
#net.off::before{background:var(--warn)}

/* left menu (YouTube's guide): full, or mini with the label under the icon */
.side{grid-area:side;position:sticky;top:56px;height:calc(100vh - 56px);overflow-y:auto;padding:12px;background:var(--bg)}
nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}
nav button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;width:100%;min-height:48px;padding:0 12px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:none;color:var(--ink);font-size:15px;font-weight:400;text-align:left}
nav button:hover{background:var(--chip)}
nav button.on{background:var(--chip);font-weight:500}
nav button.on:hover{background:var(--chip2)}
body.navmini{grid-template-columns:76px 1fr}
body.navmini .side{padding:4px}
body.navmini nav button{flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:6px;min-height:74px;padding:14px 0;font-size:11px;text-align:center}
body.navmini nav button span{max-width:68px;line-height:1.2}

/* main */
main{grid-area:main;padding:20px 24px;min-width:0}
section{display:none}section.on{display:block}
.pagehead{margin:2px 0 16px}
.pagehead h2{margin:0;font-size:24px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.3px}
.pagehead p{margin:4px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
.card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:18px;margin-bottom:16px}
h3{margin:0 0 14px;font-size:16px;font-weight:500}
h4{font-weight:500}
input,select{font:inherit;color:var(--ink);min-height:44px;padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid var(--fieldline);border-radius:8px;background:var(--field);min-width:0;width:100%;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s}
input::placeholder{color:var(--muted)}
input:focus,select:focus{outline:0;border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent)}
button{font:inherit;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink);min-height:40px;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:18px;border:0;background:var(--chip);cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s}
button:hover{background:var(--chip2)}
button:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:default}
button.primary{background:var(--strong);color:var(--onstrong)}
button.primary:hover{background:var(--strong);opacity:.85}
button.danger{color:var(--bad)}
button.danger:hover{background:var(--badsoft)}
button.sm{min-height:36px;min-width:36px;padding:6px 12px}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}
th,td{text-align:left;padding:12px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
th{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.3px;text-transform:uppercase;background:var(--panel);position:sticky;top:0}
tbody tr:hover{background:var(--chip)}
.num{text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}
.form{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:14px;align-items:end}
.form>.row{grid-column:1/-1}
label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted)}
.row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.muted{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;font-weight:400}
.warn{color:var(--warn);font-weight:500}.bad{color:var(--bad);font-weight:500}
.scroll{max-height:60vh;overflow:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;margin-top:12px}
.scroll td:first-child,.scroll th:first-child{padding-left:14px}

/* sell screen */
#sell.on{display:grid;height:calc(100vh - 96px)}
.sell{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 380px;gap:20px;min-height:0}
.catalog{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0;min-width:0}  /* many owner chips scroll instead of widening the page */
.searchbar{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;background:var(--field);border:1px solid var(--fieldline);border-radius:40px;padding:2px 4px 2px 18px}
.searchbar:focus-within{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent)}
.searchbar svg{width:20px;height:20px;stroke:var(--muted);fill:none;stroke-width:2;flex:none}
#scan{border:0;box-shadow:none;background:none;font-size:18px;padding:10px 4px}
.chips.owners{margin-top:12px;flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:2px;scrollbar-width:none}
.owners button{flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.owners .dot{width:8px;height:8px}
.tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(175px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:12px;overflow:auto;align-content:start;padding:2px 2px 12px}
.tiles>p{grid-column:1/-1}
.tile{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:8px;text-align:left;min-height:132px;padding:12px;
  border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink);font-weight:400}
.tile:hover{background:var(--raised);border-color:var(--line2)}
.tile:active{transform:scale(.98)}
.tile .tname{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start}
.tile b{font-size:15px;line-height:1.3;font-weight:500;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
.tile .owner{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.dot{display:inline-block;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;flex:none;vertical-align:middle}
.tfoot{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-top:auto}
.tfoot .price{font-size:19px;font-weight:700}
.stock{font-size:13px;font-weight:500;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--chip);color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}
.stock.low{background:var(--warnsoft);color:var(--warn)}
.stock.bad{background:var(--badsoft);color:var(--bad)}
.ini{display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:17px;border:0}
.tile.off :is(.tname,.owner,.price){opacity:.55}  /* the Expired / Out badge stays readable */

.ticket{display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;min-height:0;overflow:hidden}
.ticket-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:12px 12px 12px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.ticket-head b{font-size:17px;font-weight:500;margin-right:8px}
.ticket-items{flex:1;overflow:auto;min-height:80px}
.ticket-items td{padding:10px 8px;vertical-align:middle}
.ticket-items td:first-child{padding-left:18px}.ticket-items td:last-child{padding-right:18px}
.ticket-items td .muted{font-size:13px}
.ticket-items tr:hover{background:none}
.lname{font-weight:500;line-height:1.3}
.stepper{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;border-radius:18px;background:var(--chip)}
.stepper button{background:none;min-height:34px;min-width:34px;padding:0;border-radius:50%;font-size:17px}
.stepper button:hover{background:var(--chip2)}
.stepper span{min-width:22px;text-align:center;font-weight:500}
.empty{color:var(--muted);text-align:center;padding:44px 18px!important;border:0}
.empty svg{width:40px;height:40px;stroke:var(--muted);fill:none;stroke-width:1.5;display:block;margin:0 auto 10px}
.ticket-foot{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:14px 18px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.sumrow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline}
.sumrow span{font-weight:500}
.total{font-size:30px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.5px}
.cashbox{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;border:1px solid var(--fieldline);border-radius:10px;background:var(--field);padding:0 4px 0 12px}
.cashbox:focus-within{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent)}
.cashbox span{color:var(--muted);font-size:18px}
.cashbox input{border:0;box-shadow:none;background:none;font-size:18px;padding:10px 4px;min-height:46px}
.cashbox .iconbtn{width:34px;height:34px;min-height:34px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.later{gap:4px;font-size:12px}
.paywith{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:4px;padding:3px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--chip)}
.paywith button{min-height:38px;padding:4px 2px;border-radius:8px;background:none;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.paywith button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
.epay{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.2fr);gap:8px}
.epay label{gap:4px;font-size:12px}
.epay .cashbox{padding:0 4px 0 10px}.epay .cashbox input{font-size:16px;min-height:44px}
.quickcash{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.quickcash:empty{display:none}
.quickcash button{flex:1;min-height:40px;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:8px;font-size:14px}
.change b{font-size:30px;letter-spacing:-.5px;font-weight:700}
.change b.good{color:var(--good)}
.pay{background:var(--strong);color:var(--onstrong);font-size:18px;font-weight:500;min-height:54px;padding:14px;border-radius:27px;width:100%}
.pay:hover{background:var(--strong);opacity:.85}
.pay:disabled{background:var(--chip);color:var(--muted);opacity:1}
.ghost{background:none;color:var(--muted)}
.ghost:hover{background:var(--badsoft);color:var(--bad)}

/* pop-ups */
dialog{border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:22px;width:min(380px,92vw);background:var(--raised);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:var(--shade)}
dialog::backdrop{background:rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
#doneDlg{width:min(400px,92vw)}
#updDlg{width:min(480px,92vw)}
#updDlg.major #updTitle{color:var(--bad)}
#appUpdate.major{background:var(--alert);color:#fff}
.donecheck{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--goodsoft);color:var(--good);font-size:30px;font-weight:700;display:grid;place-items:center;margin:0 auto}
.donesum{background:var(--chip);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 16px;margin:16px 0 8px;display:grid;gap:6px}
.donechange{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:8px}
.donechange b{font-size:30px;font-weight:700;color:var(--good)}
.qtyrow{flex-wrap:nowrap;margin:18px 0 10px}
.qtyrow button{font-size:26px;width:58px;height:56px;padding:0;flex:none;border-radius:50%}
.qtyrow input{font-size:28px;font-weight:700;text-align:center;height:56px}
#qtyQuick{margin-bottom:18px}#qtyQuick button{flex:1}
#qtyDlg .primary{padding:12px;font-size:16px}
#toast{position:fixed;bottom:24px;left:24px;background:var(--strong);color:var(--onstrong);padding:14px 18px;border-radius:8px;display:none;max-width:min(560px,90vw);z-index:9;box-shadow:var(--shade);font-size:14px}
#toast.err{background:var(--alert);color:#fff}

/* product photos */
.pimg{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:8px;object-fit:cover;flex:none;background:var(--chip)}
.tname{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;width:100%}
.namecell{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}
.namecell .pimg{width:36px;height:36px}
#qtyHead{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center}
#qtyHead .pimg{width:72px;height:72px}
.photofield{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.photofield .pimg{width:72px;height:72px}
.photofield label.btn{flex-direction:row;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink);min-height:40px;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:18px;background:var(--chip);cursor:pointer;align-items:center}
.photofield label.btn:hover{background:var(--chip2)}

/* settings: section list on the left (YouTube settings), one panel of setting rows on the right */
.setwrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:220px minmax(0,1fr);gap:20px;align-items:start}
.setnav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;position:sticky;top:72px}
.setnav button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;justify-content:flex-start;min-height:44px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:10px;background:none;font-size:14px;font-weight:400;text-align:left}
.setnav button:hover{background:var(--chip)}
.setnav button.on{background:var(--chip);font-weight:500}
.setnav svg.i{width:22px;height:22px}
.setgroup{margin:14px 12px 4px;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px}.setgroup:first-child{margin-top:0}
.setpane{margin:0}
.sethint{margin:-8px 0 8px}
.setrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(160px,1fr) minmax(0,1.3fr);gap:20px;align-items:center;padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.setrow:last-of-type{border-bottom:0}
.setrow b{display:block;font-weight:500}
.setrow small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;margin-top:2px}
.setrow .ctl{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap;min-width:0}
.setrow .ctl select{flex:1}
.setfoot{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
#setform .setrow:nth-last-child(2){border-bottom:0}
.verlist{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:4px 16px;margin:8px 0 0;font-size:14px}
.verlist dt{color:var(--muted)}.verlist dd{margin:0;font-weight:500}
.url{font-weight:500;word-break:break-all;text-align:right}
.switch{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;width:44px;min-width:44px;height:24px;min-height:24px;padding:0;border-radius:12px;border:0;background:var(--track);position:relative;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s}
.switch::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:3px;left:3px;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.3);transition:transform .15s}
.switch:checked{background:var(--accent)}
.switch:checked::after{transform:translateX(20px)}
.switch:focus{box-shadow:none}.switch:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
.themeopts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:6px}
.themeopts button{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:4px;padding:12px;border-radius:12px;background:none;border:1px solid var(--line);text-align:left;min-height:0}
.themeopts button:hover{background:var(--chip)}
.themeopts button[aria-pressed=true]{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent)}
.themeopts small{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;font-weight:400}
.tp{display:block;width:100%;height:64px;border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:6px;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.tp-light{background:linear-gradient(#fff 0 22%,#f2f2f2 22% 100%)}
.tp-dark{background:linear-gradient(#0f0f0f 0 22%,#272727 22% 100%)}
.tp-auto{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff 0 50%,#0f0f0f 50% 100%)}
.tp-system{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff 0 50%,#0f0f0f 50% 100%)}
@media(max-width:1100px) and (min-width:701px){.themeopts{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:900px){.setgroup{display:none}.setwrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}.setnav{position:static;flex-direction:row;overflow-x:auto;gap:8px}
  .setnav button{flex:none;gap:8px;background:var(--chip);border-radius:8px;min-height:40px}.setnav button.on{background:var(--strong);color:var(--onstrong)}}
@media(max-width:700px){.setrow{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:8px}.setrow .ctl{justify-content:flex-start}.themeopts{grid-template-columns:1fr}.url{text-align:left}}
#appNotes{background:var(--chip);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 16px;margin-top:8px;font-size:14px}
.notelist{margin:6px 0 0;padding-left:20px}
.notemore{margin-top:8px}.notemore summary{cursor:pointer;color:var(--accent);font-weight:500;min-height:32px;display:list-item}.notemore .notelist{max-height:40vh;overflow:auto;font-size:13px}
#appNotes.fresh{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--accent)}
.chips{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.chips button{border-radius:8px}
.chips button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--strong);color:var(--onstrong)}

/* list screens (products, sellers, labels, history): toolbar, tiles, edit pop-ups */
.toolbar{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px}
.toolbar select{width:auto;min-width:150px;min-height:40px}
.search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex:1;min-width:220px;border:1px solid var(--fieldline);border-radius:20px;background:var(--field);padding:0 14px}
.search:focus-within{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent)}
.search svg{width:18px;height:18px;stroke:var(--muted);fill:none;stroke-width:2;flex:none}
.search input{border:0;box-shadow:none;background:none;min-height:40px;padding:0}
.kpis.four{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));margin-bottom:16px}
.formdlg{width:min(760px,94vw);padding:0}
.formdlg .dlghead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:16px 16px 4px 22px}
