    if (s.settings.web_app_url !== API) await Local.call("/api/settings", {web_app_url: API});  // used in the rent reminder emails
    s.photos = Object.fromEntries((await Local.call("/api/photos", {})).map(r => [r.product_id, r.photo]));
    s.drawer = await Local.call("/api/drawer-state");
    s.payouts = await Local.call("/api/payouts");
    s.credits = await Local.call("/api/credits");

}

// Send this device's changes to Google, then get everyone else's. Sales carry a uid, so a retry never double-counts.
// Callers share a running sync (and wait for it) instead of starting a second one.
const sync = () => sync.p || (sync.p = syncNow().finally(() => sync.p = null));
async function syncNow() {
  const sales = Local.pendingSaleUids().size, wasOffline = !online, before = Local.failed().length;
  try {
    await Local.sync(remoteApi); setOnline(true);

    const f = Local.failed();

}
function renderAll() {

}

// ---------- tabs ----------

$("#navToggle").onclick = () => { store.set("navMini", !document.body.classList.contains("navmini")); applyNav(); };

document.querySelectorAll("nav button").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {

// ---------- barcode (Code 128-B) ----------
const C128 = ("212222 222122 222221 121223 121322 131222 122213 122312 132212 221213 221312 231212 112232 122132 122231 113222 " +
  "123122 123221 223211 221132 221231 213212 223112 312131 311222 321122 321221 312212 322112 322211 212123 212321 232121 " +
  "111323 131123 131321 112313 132113 132311 211313 231113 231311 112133 112331 132131 113123 113321 133121 313121 211331 " +
  "231131 213113 213311 213131 311123 311321 331121 312113 312311 332111 314111 221411 431111 111224 111422 121124 121421 " +
  "141122 141221 112214 112412 122114 122411 142112 142211 241211 221114 413111 241112 134111 111242 121142 121241 114212 " +
  "124112 124211 411212 421112 421211 212141 214121 412121 111143 111341 131141 114113 114311 411113 411311 113141 114131 " +
  "311141 411131 211412 211214 211232 2331112").split(" ");
function barcodeSVG(text) {
  const codes = [104, ...[...text].map(c => c.charCodeAt(0) - 32)];
  const check = codes.reduce((s, c, i) => s + c * (i || 1), 0) % 103;
  let x = 10, bars = "";
  [...[...codes, check, 106].map(c => C128[c]).join("")].forEach((w, i) => {
    if (i % 2 === 0) bars += `<rect x="${x}" width="${w}" height="40"/>`;
    x += +w;

  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${x + 10} 40" preserveAspectRatio="none" shape-rendering="crispEdges">${bars}</svg>`;
}

// ---------- selling ----------
const byCode = code => S.products.find(p => p.barcode === code);

$("#scan").oninput = () => { renderTiles(); scanNoEnter(); };
$("#scan").onkeydown = e => {

// Owner chips under the search: All, Store, and each seller with goods on a shelf (the choice is kept while selling)
let sellOwner = "";  // "" = all, "store", or a seller id
function renderOwners() {
  const ids = new Set(S.products.map(p => p.seller_id || "store"));

  $("#owners").innerHTML = chips.map(([v, label]) => `<button data-owner="${v}" aria-pressed="${v === sellOwner}">${v && v !== "store" ? `<i class="dot" style="background:${ownerColor(+v)}"></i>` : ""}${esc(label)}</button>`).join("");

$("#owners").onclick = e => { const b = e.target.closest("button"); if (b) { sellOwner = b.dataset.owner; renderTiles(); $("#scan").focus(); } };

// The product's photo (small JPEG kept on this device), or nothing when it has none
const photoImg = p => S.photos[p.id] ? `<img class="pimg" src="${esc(S.photos[p.id])}" alt="">` : "";

// Stock badge: [text, "" | "low" | "bad"]; low = at or under the seller's alert level (5 for the store's own goods)

// Each seller's items get their own colour (dot and letter), so staff can tell shelves apart at a glance; the store's own are grey

const SELLER_COLORS = ["#2563eb", "#b45309", "#9333ea", "#db2777", "#0e7490", "#4d7c0f", "#dc2626", "#4f46e5"];

// Quantity pop-up after tapping an item
let qtyFor = null;
function askQty(p) {
  if (isExpired(p)) return toast(`${p.name} is EXPIRED (${p.expiry}). Do not sell, pull it out.`, true);

  $("#qty").value = 1; $("#qty").max = left;

$("#qtyForm").onsubmit = e => {

function addToCart(p, qty = 1) {
  if (isExpired(p)) return toast(`${p.name} is EXPIRED (${p.expiry}). Do not sell, pull it out.`, true);
  const line = cart.find(l => l.id === p.id), want = (line ? line.qty : 0) + qty;

}

// Cash buttons: the exact amount, then the next round amounts a customer is likely to hand over
function cashOptions(total) {
  const ups = new Set([20, 50, 100, 500, 1000].map(n => Math.ceil(total / n) * n).filter(v => v > total));
  return [...ups].sort((a, b) => a - b).slice(0, 4);
}
function renderCart() {
  $("#cart").innerHTML = cart.map((l, i) => `<tr><td><div class="lname">${esc(l.name)}</div><div class="muted">${peso(l.price)} each</div></td>
    <td><div class="stepper"><button data-i="${i}" data-d="-1" aria-label="One less">−</button><span>${l.qty}</span><button data-i="${i}" data-d="1" aria-label="One more">+</button></div></td>
    <td class="num">${peso(l.price * l.qty)}</td></tr>`).join("")
    || `<tr><td class="empty"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 5V3h4M17 3h4v2M21 19v2h-4M7 21H3v-2M7 8v8M10 8v8M13 8v8M17 8v8"/></svg>Scan a barcode or tap an item to start</td></tr>`;

  document.querySelectorAll("#paywith button").forEach(b => b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", b.dataset.via === payVia));

  $("#clear").hidden = !cart.length;

  $("#pay").disabled = !cart.length;
  $("#total").textContent = peso(total);
  $("#quickcash").innerHTML = due ? `<button data-cash="exact">Exact</button>` + cashOptions(due).map(v => `<button data-cash="${v}">${peso(v).replace(".00", "")}</button>`).join("") : "";
  $("#cashClear").hidden = !$("#cash").value;

}
// Paid by: cash, or GCash / Maya / bank QR for all of it (or part, with the rest in cash). Each sale starts as cash.
const PAY_LATER = "Pay later";
$("#paywith").innerHTML = ["", ...PAY_VIA, PAY_LATER].map(v => `<button type="button" data-via="${v}">${v || "Cash"}</button>`).join("");
$("#paywith").onclick = e => {

// What is left to pay in cash: everything, or what the e-wallet part doesn't cover (blank e-wallet amount = all of it)
function amounts() {
  const total = Math.round(cart.reduce((s, l) => s + l.price * l.qty, 0) * 100) / 100;
  const typed = parseFloat($("#epay").value), epay = payVia ? (typed > 0 ? Math.round(typed * 100) / 100 : total) : 0;
  if (payVia === PAY_LATER) return {total, epay: 0, due: 0};

$("#epay").oninput = renderCart;
$("#epay").onkeydown = e => { if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); $("#eref").focus(); } };
// Enter after the reference moves on but never charges: a product scanned here by mistake must not finish the sale
$("#eref").onkeydown = e => { if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); (amounts().due ? $("#cash") : $("#pay")).focus(); } };
$("#cart").onclick = e => {
  const b = e.target.closest("button"); if (!b) return;
  const l = cart[b.dataset.i];
  if (l.qty === 1 && b.dataset.d === "-1") cart.splice(b.dataset.i, 1);  // − on the last one takes the item out
  else addToCart(S.products.find(p => p.id === l.id), +b.dataset.d);

$("#cash").oninput = renderCart;
$("#cashClear").onclick = () => { $("#cash").value = ""; renderCart(); $("#cash").focus(); };
$("#quickcash").onclick = e => {
  const b = e.target.closest("button"); if (!b) return;
  const {due} = amounts();

$("#cash").onkeydown = e => {
  if (e.key !== "Enter") return;
  const v = e.target.value.trim();
  if (isBarcode(v)) {  // a scan while the cash box was selected: add the product instead of charging
    e.preventDefault(); e.target.value = ""; renderCart();

// Cash is never 7+ digits (₱1,000,000); barcodes are (in-store 8, EAN-8, UPC 12, EAN 13)
const isBarcode = v => /^\d{7,}$/.test(v);

const receiptNo = s => s.uid ? s.uid.slice(-6).toUpperCase() : String(s.id);  // printed on the receipt
let paying = false;  // a double F2 / double click must not record the sale twice
const pay = run(async () => {
  if (paying) return;
  if (!cart.length) return toast("Cart is empty", true);
  const {total, epay, due} = amounts(), later = payVia === PAY_LATER, via = later ? "" : payVia;
  let ref = $("#eref").value.trim(), who = $("#laterName").value.trim();
  if (later && !who) {
    paying = true;
    try { who = String(await ask(`Who will pay the ${peso(total)} later?`) ?? "").trim(); } finally { paying = false; }
    if (!who) return toast("Enter who will pay, to finish the sale", true);
  }
  if (via) {
    if (epay > total) return toast(`The ${via} amount (${peso(epay)}) is more than the total (${peso(total)})`, true);
    if (ref.length < 4) {  // the number on the customer's "sent" screen: proof the money arrived
      paying = true;
      try { ref = String(await ask(`${via} reference number of ${peso(epay)} (on the customer's confirmation screen; the last 4 digits are enough)`) ?? "").trim(); }
      finally { paying = false; }
      if (ref.length < 4) return toast(`Enter the ${via} reference number to finish the sale`, true);
      $("#eref").value = ref;
    }
  }
  if (isBarcode($("#cash").value.trim())) { $("#cash").value = ""; renderCart(); return toast("That cash amount was a barcode, not cash. Scan the item again and enter the cash received.", true); }
  let cash = due ? parseFloat($("#cash").value) : 0;  // all paid by e-wallet: no cash
  if (due && !(cash > 0)) {  // never assume the exact amount: the cashier types what the customer gave (or taps a cash button)
    paying = true;
    try { const a = String(await ask(via ? `Rest to pay in cash: ${peso(due)}. How much cash did the customer give?` : `How much cash did the customer give? Total: ${peso(total)}`, "", "number") ?? "").trim();
          cash = isBarcode(a) ? NaN : parseFloat(a); }  // a scan into this box is not cash
    finally { paying = false; }
    if (!(cash > 0)) return toast("Enter the cash received to finish the sale", true);
    $("#cash").value = cash; renderCart();
  }
  if (cash < due) return toast(`Cash received (${peso(cash)}) is less than ${via ? "the rest to pay" : "the total"} (${peso(due)})`, true);
  const sale = {uid: newUid(), ts: localTime(), cash,
                ...(later ? {credit_to: who} : {}), ...(via ? {pay_via: via, epay, epay_ref: ref} : {}), items: cart.map(({id, qty, price, name}) => ({id, qty, price, name}))};
  paying = true;
  try { lastSale = {...await api("/api/sale", sale), id: receiptNo(sale)}; }  // saved on this device at once
  finally { paying = false; }
  cart = []; resetPayment();
  await load();
  showDone(lastSale);
});

// The receipt logo, saved as "width,height,base64 of 1-bit rows"
function receiptLogo() {
  const m = /^(\d+),(\d+),(.+)$/.exec(S.settings.receipt_logo || ""); if (!m) return null;
  try { return {w: +m[1], h: +m[2], bits: Uint8Array.from(atob(m[3]), c => c.charCodeAt(0))}; } catch { return null; }
}
function logoURL(l) {  // for the screen and regular printers
  const c = document.createElement("canvas"), g = c.getContext("2d"), wb = l.w / 8;
  c.width = l.w; c.height = l.h;
  const d = g.createImageData(l.w, l.h);
  for (let i = 0; i < l.w * l.h; i++) {
    const on = l.bits[Math.floor(i / l.w) * wb + ((i % l.w) >> 3)] & (128 >> (i % l.w & 7)), v = on ? 0 : 255;
    d.data.set([v, v, v, 255], i * 4);
  }
  g.putImageData(d, 0, 0);
  return c.toDataURL("image/png");
}
// Receipt printer chosen: send it the ticket(s) and return true. Regular printer chosen: return false (caller prints HTML).
async function printTickets(parts, done) {
  const method = printerMethod();
  if (method === "browser") return false;
  const all = new Uint8Array(parts.reduce((n, p) => n + p.length, 0));
  parts.reduce((at, p) => (all.set(p, at), at + p.length), 0);
  try { await PRINTERS[method](all); if (done) toast(done); } catch (e) { toast("Printer: " + (e.message || e), true); }
  return true;
}

// Bytes to base64 in pieces: a big label job is too long for one call
const b64 = bytes => { let s = ""; for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 8190) s += String.fromCharCode(...bytes.slice(i, i + 8190)); return btoa(s); };

// ---------- Bluetooth receipt printers (58 mm, ESC/POS, e.g. Goojprt PT-210 / "MTP-II") ----------
// Browsers can't send to these through the normal Print dialog, so the POS sends printer commands itself.
// A 58 mm ticket (32 characters per line) built from ESC/POS printer commands
function ticket() {
  const W = 32, ESC = 0x1b, out = [ESC, 0x40];  // reset
  const clean = v => String(v ?? "").normalize("NFD").replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g, "").replace(/₱/g, "P").replace(/[^\x20-\x7e]/g, "?");
  const wrap = v => {  // word wrap; only very long words are cut
    const lines = [""];
    for (const w of clean(v).split(" ")) {
      const cur = lines[lines.length - 1];
      if (cur && (cur + " " + w).length > W) lines.push(w); else lines[lines.length - 1] = cur ? cur + " " + w : w;
    }
    return lines.flatMap(l => l.match(new RegExp(`.{1,${W}}`, "g")) || [""]);
  };
  const t = {
    money: n => (n < 0 ? "-P" : "P") + Math.abs(Number(n || 0)).toFixed(2),
    line: v => { for (const ch of clean(v)) out.push(ch.charCodeAt(0)); out.push(10); },
    text: v => wrap(v).forEach(t.line),
    lr: (l, r) => { l = clean(l); r = clean(r); const gap = W - l.length - r.length; t.line(gap > 0 ? l + " ".repeat(gap) + r : l.slice(0, W - r.length - 1) + " " + r); },
    rule: () => t.line("-".repeat(W)),
    barcode: code => {  // the printer draws Code 128 itself: few bytes, so many labels print quickly
      const b = [...code].map(c => c.charCodeAt(0));
      out.push(0x1d, 0x68, 60, 0x1d, 0x77, b.length > 15 ? 1 : 2, 0x1d, 0x48, 0, 0x1d, 0x6b, 73, b.length + 2, 0x7b, 0x42, ...b, 10);  // height, width, no text, GS k
    },
    image: l => { const w = Math.ceil(l.w / 8); out.push(0x1d, 0x76, 0x30, 0, w & 255, w >> 8, l.h & 255, l.h >> 8); for (const b of l.bits) out.push(b); out.push(10); },  // GS v 0
    bold: on => out.push(ESC, 0x45, on ? 1 : 0),
    center: on => out.push(ESC, 0x61, on ? 1 : 0),
    end: () => { t.center(0); t.line(""); t.line(""); t.line(""); return new Uint8Array(out); },  // feed past the tear bar
  };
  return t;
}

function storeHeader(t) {
  const st = S.settings;
  t.center(1); t.bold(1); t.text(storeName()); t.bold(0);
  if (st.receipt_address) t.text(st.receipt_address);
  if (st.receipt_phone) t.line(st.receipt_phone);
}

function receiptBytes(s, label = "") {
  const t = ticket(), m = t.money, logo = receiptLogo();
  if (logo) { t.center(1); t.image(logo); }
  storeHeader(t);
  t.line(`${String(s.ts).replace("T", " ").slice(0, 16)}  #${s.id}`);
  if (s.refund_of) { t.bold(1); t.line("*** REFUND ***"); t.bold(0); }
  if (label) { t.bold(1); t.line(`*** ${label} ***`); t.bold(0); }
  t.center(0); t.rule();
  s.items.forEach(i => { t.text(i.name); t.lr(`  ${i.qty} x ${m(i.price)}`, m(i.qty * i.price)); });
  t.rule();
  t.bold(1); t.lr("TOTAL", m(s.total)); t.bold(0);
  if (s.credit_to && !s.refund_of) { t.bold(1); t.line("TO PAY LATER"); t.bold(0); t.text(s.credit_to); t.line(""); t.line("Received by: _____________"); }
  else if (s.refund_of && s.credit_to) { t.text(`Returned: taken off what ${s.credit_to} owes`); t.text(`Refund of #${s.refund_of.slice(-6).toUpperCase()}: ${s.reason || ""}`); }
  else if (s.refund_of) { t.lr(`${s.pay_via || "Cash"} given back`, m(-s.total)); t.text(`Refund of #${s.refund_of.slice(-6).toUpperCase()}: ${s.reason || ""}`); }
  else {
    if (s.epay > 0) { t.lr(s.pay_via, m(s.epay)); t.text(`  Ref ${s.epay_ref}`); }
    if (!(s.epay > 0) || s.cash > 0) { t.lr("Cash", m(s.cash)); t.lr("Change", m(s.change)); }
  }
  t.center(1); t.line(""); t.text(S.settings.receipt_footer || "Salamat po! Come again.");
  return t.end();
}

function reportBytes(r) {
  const t = ticket(), m = t.money;
  storeHeader(t);
  t.bold(1); t.line("SALES REPORT"); t.bold(0);
  t.line(r.from === r.to ? r.from : `${r.from} to ${r.to}`);
  t.line("Printed " + localTime().replace("T", " ").slice(0, 16));
  t.center(0); t.rule();
  t.lr("Sales", String(r.summary.n));
  if (r.summary.refunds && r.summary.refunds.n) t.lr(`Refunds (${r.summary.refunds.n})`, t.money(-r.summary.refunds.amount));
  t.bold(1); t.lr("TOTAL", m(r.summary.total)); t.bold(0);
  if ((r.by_pay || []).some(p => p.via !== "Cash")) r.by_pay.forEach(p => t.lr(`  ${p.via} (${p.n})`, m(p.amount)));
  t.rule(); t.bold(1); t.line("BY OWNER (pay sellers)"); t.bold(0);
  r.by_owner.forEach(o => { t.text(o.owner + (o.shelf ? ` (shelf ${o.shelf})` : "")); t.lr(`  ${o.qty} pcs`, m(o.amount)); });
  if (!r.by_owner.length) t.line("  No sales");
  if (r.removed && r.removed.by_reason.length) {
    t.rule(); t.bold(1); t.line("STOCK REMOVED (not sold)"); t.bold(0);
    r.removed.by_reason.forEach(x => t.lr(`  ${x.reason} (${x.qty})`, m(x.value)));
  }
  t.rule(); t.bold(1); t.line("BY ITEM"); t.bold(0);
  r.by_item.forEach(i => { t.text(i.name); t.lr(`  ${i.qty} pcs`, m(i.amount)); });
  if (!r.by_item.length) t.line("  No sales");
  t.rule();
  return t.end();
}

const dayText = iso => new Date(iso + "T12:00").toLocaleDateString("en-PH", {month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric"});

function barcodeBits(text) {
  const codes = [104, ...[...text].map(c => c.charCodeAt(0) - 32)], check = codes.reduce((s, c, i) => s + c * (i || 1), 0) % 103;
  const widths = [...codes, check, 106].map(c => C128[c]).join(""), mods = [...widths].reduce((n, w) => n + +w, 0), k = mods * 2 <= 376 ? 2 : 1;
  const w = Math.ceil(mods * k / 8) * 8, h = 60, row = new Uint8Array(w / 8);
  let x = Math.floor((w - mods * k) / 2);
  [...widths].forEach((m, i) => { for (let d = 0; d < m * k; d++, x++) if (i % 2 === 0) row[x >> 3] |= 128 >> (x & 7); });
  const bits = new Uint8Array(row.length * h);
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) bits.set(row, y * row.length);
  return {w, h, bits};
}

}

function bytesToPaper(bytes) {  // reads the printer commands the POS uses: reset, bold, centre, new line
  let html = "", run = "", line = "", bold = false, center = false;
  const flushRun = () => { if (run) line += bold ? `<b>${esc(run)}</b>` : esc(run); run = ""; };
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
    const c = bytes[i];
    if (c === 0x1b) {
      const k = String.fromCharCode(bytes[++i]);
      if (k === "@") { flushRun(); bold = center = false; }
      else if (k === "E") { flushRun(); bold = !!bytes[++i]; }
      else if (k === "a") center = !!bytes[++i];
    } else if (c === 0x1d && bytes[i + 1] === 0x76) {
      const wb = bytes[i + 4] + bytes[i + 5] * 256, h = bytes[i + 6] + bytes[i + 7] * 256, bits = bytes.slice(i + 8, i + 8 + wb * h);
      flushRun();
      line += `<img src="${logoURL({w: wb * 8, h, bits})}" alt="" style="width:${(wb * 8 / 384 * 32).toFixed(1)}ch">`;
      i += 7 + wb * h;
    } else if (c === 10) {
      flushRun();
      html += `<div class="pl"${center ? ' style="text-align:center"' : ""}>${line}</div>`;
      line = "";
    } else run += String.fromCharCode(c);
  }

}

// The logo: at most 30 x 15 mm, black and white dots as the printer needs (dithered, so shades still show)
const LOGO_W = 240, LOGO_H = 120;
async function logoBits(file) {
  const img = await createImageBitmap(file), k = Math.min(LOGO_W / img.width, LOGO_H / img.height, 1);
  const c = document.createElement("canvas"), w = Math.ceil(Math.max(8, img.width * k) / 8) * 8, h = Math.max(1, Math.round(img.height * k));
  c.width = w; c.height = h;
  const g = c.getContext("2d");
  g.fillStyle = "#fff"; g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
  g.drawImage(img, (w - img.width * k) / 2, 0, img.width * k, h);
  const px = g.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data, gray = new Float32Array(w * h), bits = new Uint8Array(w / 8 * h);
  for (let i = 0; i < w * h; i++) gray[i] = .299 * px[i * 4] + .587 * px[i * 4 + 1] + .114 * px[i * 4 + 2];
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {  // Floyd-Steinberg
    const i = y * w + x, v = gray[i], black = v < 128, e = v - (black ? 0 : 255);
    if (black) bits[y * (w / 8) + (x >> 3)] |= 128 >> (x & 7);
    if (x + 1 < w) gray[i + 1] += e * 7 / 16;
    if (y + 1 < h) { if (x) gray[i + w - 1] += e * 3 / 16; gray[i + w] += e * 5 / 16; if (x + 1 < w) gray[i + w + 1] += e / 16; }
  }
  return `${w},${h},${btoa(String.fromCharCode(...bits))}`;
}

async function sendTexts() {
  const sms = window.Capacitor?.isPluginAvailable?.("Sms") && Capacitor.Plugins.Sms;

  if (!sms || !store.get("smsOn", false) || texting || Local.pending()) return;

    }
  } finally { texting = false; }
  if (Local.pending()) syncSoon();
}

// ---------- Settings > Barcode scanner: a scanner types very fast and usually ends with Enter ----------
const SCAN_GAP = 50;  // ms between characters: faster than any person
let scanKeys = [], scanWait = null;
function scanBeep(found, always = false) {
  if (!always && !store.get("scanBeep", false)) return;
  try {
    const a = scanBeep.a || (scanBeep.a = new AudioContext()), o = a.createOscillator(), g = a.createGain();
    o.frequency.value = found ? 1800 : 300; g.gain.value = .15;
    o.connect(g).connect(a.destination); o.start(); o.stop(a.currentTime + (found ? .07 : .25));
  } catch {}
}
// "Scanner sends no Enter": a burst of fast typing that stops counts as a finished scan
function scanNoEnter() {
  if (!store.get("scanNoEnter", false)) return;
  const now = performance.now();
  scanKeys = scanKeys.length && now - scanKeys[scanKeys.length - 1] > 100 ? [now] : scanKeys.concat(now);
  clearTimeout(scanWait);
  scanWait = setTimeout(() => {
    const n = scanKeys.length, fast = n >= 4 && (scanKeys[n - 1] - scanKeys[0]) / (n - 1) < SCAN_GAP;
    scanKeys = [];
    if (fast) { const s = $("#scan"); s.onkeydown({key: "Enter", target: s}); }
  }, 150);
}
function showScanTest(ended) {
  const v = $("#scanTest").value.trim(), n = testKeys.length, gap = n > 1 ? (testKeys[n - 1] - testKeys[0]) / (n - 1) : 999, scanner = n >= 4 && gap < SCAN_GAP;
  if (!v) return;
  const p = byCode(v), box = $("#scanResult");
  box.hidden = false;
  box.innerHTML = `<b>${scanner ? '<span style="color:var(--good)">✓ Scanner working</span>' : "That looked typed by hand"}</b> · code ${esc(v)}<br>${p ? `In your products: ${esc(p.name)}, ${peso(p.price)}` : "Not in your products yet"}`
    + (scanner && !ended ? '<br><span class="warn">It sends no Enter: turn on "Scanner sends no Enter" below.</span>' : "");
  scanBeep(!!p);
  $("#scanTest").value = ""; testKeys = [];
}
let testKeys = [], testWait = null;
$("#scanTest").oninput = () => { testKeys.push(performance.now()); clearTimeout(testWait); testWait = setTimeout(() => { if (testKeys.length >= 4 && (testKeys[testKeys.length - 1] - testKeys[0]) / (testKeys.length - 1) < SCAN_GAP) showScanTest(false); }, 300); };
$("#scanTest").onkeydown = e => { if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); clearTimeout(testWait); showScanTest(true); } };
$("#scanBeep").onchange = e => { store.set("scanBeep", e.target.checked); scanBeep(true); };

});

// ---------- Scan in stock: each scan of the item's own barcode counts one piece; nothing changes until Add to stock ----------
let sin = {p: null, n: 0, link: ""};  // the product, pieces scanned, a new barcode to link to it
function renderScanIn() {
  const p = sin.p;
  $("#sinItem").innerHTML = p ? `${thumb(p)}<div><b>${esc(p.name)}</b><small>${p.stock} in stock · barcode ${esc(sin.link || p.barcode)}</small></div>`
    : '<div><b>Scan any item to start</b><small>The barcode tells the POS which product it is</small></div>';
  $("#sinCount").textContent = sin.n;

}
const sinSay = (text, kind = "") => { $("#sinMsg").textContent = text; $("#sinMsg").className = "sinmsg " + kind; };
function openScanIn(p = null) {
  sin = {p, n: 0, link: ""};
  const f = $("#sinForm"); f.reset();
  if (p) { f.expiry.value = p.expiry || ""; f.notify_on.value = p.notify_on || ""; }
  sinSay(p ? "Scan each piece of this item." : "");

  $("#sinDlg").showModal(); $("#sinScan").focus();

function scanIn(code) {
  const hit = byCode(code), p = sin.p;
  if (!p && !hit) { scanBeep(false, true); return sinSay(`${code} is not in your products. Open the product and tap + then Scan pieces instead to link it.`, "bad"); }
  if (!p) {
    sin.p = hit; sin.n = 1;
    $("#sinForm").expiry.value = hit.expiry || ""; $("#sinForm").notify_on.value = hit.notify_on || "";
  } else if (hit === p || code === sin.link) sin.n++;
  else if (hit) { scanBeep(false, true); return sinSay(`That is ${hit.name}, not ${p.name}. Not counted.`, "bad"); }
  else if (!sin.link && /^20\d{6}$/.test(p.barcode)) { sin.link = code; sin.n++; }  // an in-store code: this item's own barcode replaces it
  else { scanBeep(false, true); return sinSay(`That barcode isn't ${p.name}'s. Not counted.`, "bad"); }
  scanBeep(true, true);
  sinSay(sin.link ? `Barcode ${sin.link} will be linked to this item.` : "Counted.", sin.link ? "warn" : "good");
  renderScanIn();
}

// End-of-day printout: receipt printer, or a normal printer
function countBytes(p) {
  const t = ticket(), m = t.money;
  storeHeader(t);
  t.bold(1); t.line("CASH DRAWER COUNT"); t.bold(0);
  t.center(0); t.lr("Opened", when(p.opened)); t.lr("Closed", when(p.closed)); t.rule();
  t.lr(`Sales (${p.n})`, m(p.total));
  p.by_pay.forEach(x => t.lr(`  ${x.via}`, m(x.amount)));
  t.rule();
  t.lr("Starting cash", m(p.start)); t.lr("Cash sales", m(p.cash_sales)); t.lr("Money in", m(p.ins)); t.lr("Money out", "-" + m(p.outs));
  p.moves.forEach(x => t.text(`  ${x.ts.slice(11, 16)} ${x.kind === "in" ? "+" : "-"}${m(x.amount)} ${x.note || ""}`));
  t.bold(1); t.lr("EXPECTED", m(p.expected)); t.lr("COUNTED", m(p.counted));
  t.lr(p.diff === 0 ? "EXACT" : p.diff < 0 ? "SHORT" : "OVER", m(Math.abs(p.diff))); t.bold(0);
  if (p.detail) t.text("Count: " + p.detail);
  if (p.note) t.text("Note: " + p.note);
  t.rule(); t.line(""); t.line("Counted by: ______________"); t.line(""); t.line("Checked by: ______________");
  return t.end();
}
const printCount = run(async p => {
  if (await printTickets([countBytes(p)], "Count printed")) return;
  const row = (k, v) => `<tr><td>${k}</td><td class="num">${v}</td></tr>`;
  printHTML([`<div class="report"><h2>${esc(storeName())}: Cash drawer count</h2><p>Opened ${when(p.opened)} · closed ${when(p.closed)}</p><table>
    ${row(`Sales (${p.n})`, peso(p.total))}${p.by_pay.map(x => row("  " + esc(x.via), peso(x.amount))).join("")}
    ${row("Starting cash", peso(p.start))}${row("Cash sales", peso(p.cash_sales))}${row("Money in", peso(p.ins))}${row("Money out", "−" + peso(p.outs))}
    ${p.moves.map(x => row(`  ${x.ts.slice(11, 16)} ${esc(x.note || "")}`, (x.kind === "in" ? "+" : "−") + peso(x.amount))).join("")}
    ${row("<b>Expected</b>", `<b>${peso(p.expected)}</b>`)}${row("<b>Counted</b>", `<b>${peso(p.counted)}</b>`)}
    ${row(`<b>${p.diff === 0 ? "Exact" : p.diff < 0 ? "Short" : "Over"}</b>`, `<b>${peso(Math.abs(p.diff))}</b>`)}</table>

    <p style="margin-top:40px">Counted by: ____________________   Checked by: ____________________</p></div>`]);
});

  $("#txlist").innerHTML = (S.texts || []).map(t => `<tr><td>${when(t.created)}</td><td>${esc(t.to_phone)}</td><td>${esc(t.body)}</td>
    <td>${t.sent ? "sent" : t.error ? `<span class="bad">${esc(t.error)}</span> <button class="sm" data-retext="${t.id}">Try again</button>` : '<span class="warn">waiting</span>'}</td></tr>`).join("")
    || '<tr><td colspan="4" class="muted">No text messages yet.</td></tr>';
  $("#obinfo").textContent = `Emails are sent from your Gmail${S.quota != null ? ` (${S.quota} more allowed today)` : ""}. Alerts are checked every hour.`;
  $("#oblist").innerHTML = S.outbox.map(m => `<tr><td>${m.created.replace("T", " ")}</td><td>${esc(m.to_addr)}</td><td>${esc(m.subject)}</td>

    <td class="num">${m.sent ? "" : `<button class="sm" data-readdress="${m.id}">Change email</button> `}<button class="sm danger" data-delmail="${m.id}">Delete</button></td></tr>`).join("")
    || `<tr><td colspan="5" class="muted">No emails yet. An email is created when a seller's item reaches its notify date, expires or runs low,
         or when you click <b>Email stock</b> in Sellers & Shelves. Use <b>Send test email</b> to check your settings.</td></tr>`;
}

// ---------- software update (installed app): downloads the newest POS from GitHub Pages (app-build.js makes it) ----------
const WEB_URL = "https://goodmickey.github.io/pos/", UPDATE_URL = WEB_URL + "app-update.json";
$("#webUrl").textContent = WEB_URL;
const versionText = v => new Date(v * 1000).toLocaleString("en-PH", {dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short"});
// The installed app itself can be replaced too (a "major update"): Android installs a new APK (AppUpdatePlugin.java),
// Mac/Windows swap their app package (desktop/main.js). info() -> {name, code}; newer(u, info) -> {name, url} or null.
const newerVersion = (a, b) => { const x = String(a).split(".").map(Number), y = String(b).split(".").map(Number);
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) if ((x[i] || 0) !== (y[i] || 0)) return (x[i] || 0) > (y[i] || 0); return false; };
const appShell = window.desktopApp ? {
  info: async () => ({name: await desktopApp.version()}),
  newer: (u, i) => u.desktop && newerVersion(u.desktop.version, i.name) ? {name: u.desktop.version, url: u.desktop.url} : null,
  install: url => desktopApp.update(url),
  how: "It downloads, installs and restarts the app by itself (a few seconds). Your data stays.",
} : window.Capacitor?.isPluginAvailable?.("AppUpdate") ? {
  info: async () => { const r = await Capacitor.Plugins.AppUpdate.info(); return {name: r.versionName, code: r.versionCode}; },
  newer: (u, i) => u.android && u.android.versionCode > i.code ? {name: u.android.versionName, url: u.android.url} : null,
  install: url => Capacitor.Plugins.AppUpdate.install({url}),
  how: "It downloads, then Android asks \"Do you want to update this app?\": tap Update, then Open. Your data stays.",
} : null;
let shellInfo = null;  // this app's own version, shown in Settings

// The update pop-up; resolves true for "Install now"
function askUpdate(u, major) {
  return new Promise(ok => {
    const d = $("#updDlg");
    d.classList.toggle("major", !!major);
    $("#updTitle").textContent = major ? "Major software update" : "Software update";
    $("#updInfo").textContent = major ? `A new version of the app is ready: version ${major.name} (you have ${shellInfo.name}).`
      : `A new version of the POS is ready (${versionText(u.version)}).`;
    $("#updNotes").innerHTML = notesHTML(u.keynotes, u.notes);
    $("#updHow").textContent = major ? appShell.how : "It installs in a few seconds. Your data stays.";
    $("#updGo").onclick = () => { d.close(); ok(true); };
    $("#updLater").onclick = () => { d.close(); ok(false); };
    d.oncancel = () => ok(false);
    d.showModal();
  });
}

// quiet = the check when the app starts: a major update is offered in its pop-up, a small one only mentioned
async function checkUpdate(quiet) {
  let u;
  try { u = await (await fetch(UPDATE_URL + "?t=" + Date.now(), {cache: "no-store"})).json(); }
  catch { if (quiet) return; throw new Error("Can't check for updates: no internet"); }
  const major = appShell && appShell.newer(u, shellInfo || (shellInfo = await appShell.info()));  // it has the newest POS inside too
  if (!major && !(u.version > window.APP_VERSION)) return quiet || toast("This app is up to date");
  if (major) { $("#appUpdate").textContent = `Install major update (${major.name})`; $("#appUpdate").classList.add("major"); }
  if (quiet && (!major || cart.length)) return toast(`${major ? "Major software update" : "Software update"} available: Settings → Software update`);
  if (cart.length) return toast("Finish or cancel the current sale first, then update", true);
  if (!await askUpdate(u, major)) return;
  store.set("justUpdated", true);  // after the restart: open Settings on what's new
  if (major) {
    store.set("expectApp", major.name);  // checked after the restart
    toast("Downloading the new version…");
    try { await appShell.install(major.url); } catch (e) { store.set("justUpdated", false); throw e; }
    return;
  }
  localStorage.setItem("posUpdate", JSON.stringify(u)); localStorage.removeItem("posTrying");
  location.replace("index.html");  // the start page picks up the new version
}
if (window.APP_VERSION) {
  $("#appUpdate").hidden = false;
  // App version, then the date and time this version was published
  const when = new Date(APP_VERSION * 1000);
  $("#verList").hidden = false; $("#appVersion").hidden = true;
  $("#verDate").textContent = when.toLocaleDateString("en-PH", {month: "long", day: "numeric", year: "numeric"});
  $("#verTime").textContent = when.toLocaleTimeString("en-PH", {hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit"});
  if (appShell) appShell.info().then(i => { shellInfo = i; $("#verApp").textContent = i.name; }).catch(() => {});
  if (window.APP_NOTES?.length) {
    $("#appNotesBody").innerHTML = notesHTML(window.APP_KEYNOTES, APP_NOTES);
    $("#appNotes").hidden = false;
  }
  $("#appUpdate").onclick = run(async () => {
    $("#appUpdate").disabled = true;
    try { await checkUpdate(false); } finally { $("#appUpdate").disabled = false; }
  });
}

// Every 30 s (and right after a change): sync with Google, then show the result (other devices' sales and changes)
let lastTickError = "";  // background refresh: show a problem once, not again every 30 seconds
async function tick() {
  try { await sync(); await load(); lastTickError = ""; }
  catch (e) { if (e.message !== lastTickError) toast(e.message, true); lastTickError = e.message; }
}
(async () => {
  await Local.open();
  // Offline sales an older POS version kept in the browser: hand them to this device's database to send
  const old = store.get("queue", []);
  for (const s of old) await Local.addOp("/api/sale", s);
  if (old.length) store.set("queue", []);
  tick(); setInterval(tick, 30000);
  try { localStorage.removeItem("posTrying"); } catch {}  // this version started fine (see app-build.js)
  if (window.APP_VERSION && store.get("justUpdated", false)) {  // a Software update just finished: show what it changed
    store.set("justUpdated", false);
    document.querySelector('nav [data-tab="settings"]').click(); showSettingsPane("update");
    $("#appNotes").classList.add("fresh"); $("#appNotes").scrollIntoView({block: "center"});
    const expect = store.get("expectApp", ""); store.set("expectApp", "");
    const now = expect && appShell ? (await appShell.info()).name : expect;
    if (now !== expect) toast(`The app update didn't install (still version ${now}). Try Software update again, or use the installer from the Desktop folder.`, true);
    else toast("Update installed. What's new is listed under the app version.");
  }
  if (window.APP_VERSION) setTimeout(() => checkUpdate(true), 5000);
})();
// Web version: keep a copy of the page so it opens with no internet (the installed apps have their files built in)
if (!window.APP_VERSION && "serviceWorker" in navigator) navigator.serviceWorker.register("sw.js").catch(() => {});
addEventListener("online", tick);
netStatus();
